description: An active compression exercise strengthening hip flexors and lower abdominals while seated on the floor.
setup: Sit upright on the floor with legs extended straight together and palms placed flat on the floor beside your thighs.
steps: Press palms into the floor and brace your abdominals.
Point your toes and lift both straight legs several inches off the floor.
Pause for a brief count at the peak height.
Lower legs with control back to the floor without slamming.
cues: Point toes and lock knees straight throughout the lift
Lean forward slightly rather than falling back onto your tailbone

mistakes.mistake: Leaning far back to compensate for weak hip flexors
mistakes.fix: Keep torso upright or slightly angled forward over your thighs
Keep quads squeezed tight and legs completely straight

rep_standard: Begins with heels on the floor, lifts both straight legs clearly off the ground without leaning back, and returns under control.
